2608.01292.title: CrossLex: A Source-Grounded Benchmark for Cross-Jurisdictional Legal Reasoning in Large Language Models
2608.01292.paper_summary: Legal reasoning is inherently jurisdiction-dependent: the same facts can call for different legal rules and yield different conclusions across legal systems. Yet existing benchmarks rarely evaluate whether large language models (LLMs) can recognize such jurisdiction-specific variation, especially when identical fact patterns lead to divergent legal outcomes.We introduce CrossLex, a same-fact, legal-source-grounded benchmark for evaluating cross-jurisdictional legal reasoning in LLMs across three jurisdictions: China, California, and Germany. Built from authoritative legal sources, CrossLex aligns 55 legal issues spanning contract, consumer, criminal, family, and labor law, and constructs jurisdiction-aligned questions paired with answers and supporting citations. In total, CrossLex contains 6,149 instances organized into 385 fact groups, with all legal issues, answers, and cited authorities reviewed by legal professionals.To disentangle basic legal knowledge from cross-jurisdictional reasoning, CrossLex defines three complementary tasks: single-jurisdiction reasoning (T1), joint cross-jurisdictional comparison (T2), and fine-grained cross-jurisdictional evaluation (T3). We further propose Grounded Joint, a metric that jointly assesses answer correctness and legal-source grounding, and provide a unified evaluation for streamlined benchmarking. Extensive experiments on representative LLMs show that, although current models can often answer legal questions correctly, they struggle to provide accurate cross-jurisdictional legal citations.We hope that CrossLex will facilitate future research on source-grounded cross-jurisdictional legal reasoning.
2608.01292.paper_summary_zh: 法律推理本質上依賴於管轄權：相同的事實在不同的法律系統中可能需要不同的法律規則並得出不同的結論。<lb/>然而，現有的基準很少評估大型語言模型（LLMs）是否能識別這種特定於管轄權的變化，尤其是當相同的事實模式導致不同的法律結果時。<lb/>我們介紹了CrossLex，一個基於相同事實和法律來源的基準，用於評估LLMs在中國、加利福尼亞州和德國三個管轄區的跨管轄法律推理。<lb/>CrossLex基於權威法律來源，涵蓋55個法律問題，涉及合同、消費者、刑事、家庭和勞動法，並構建了與答案和支持引用配對的管轄權對齊問題。<lb/>總共，CrossLex包含6,149個實例，組織成385個事實組，所有法律問題、答案和引用的權威均由法律專業人士審核。<lb/>為了將基本法律知識與跨管轄推理區分開來，CrossLex定義了三個互補任務：單一管轄推理（T1）、聯合跨管轄比較（T2）和細緻的跨管轄評估（T3）。<lb/>我們進一步提出了Grounded Joint，一個共同評估答案正確性和法律來源基礎的指標，並提供統一的評估以簡化基準測試。<lb/>在代表性LLMs上的廣泛實驗顯示，儘管當前模型通常能正確回答法律問題，但它們在提供準確的跨管轄法律引用方面仍然存在困難。<lb/>我們希望CrossLex能促進未來對基於來源的跨管轄法律推理的研究。
